inferred.intel_f_graphics: Derived by a rule: the letter F in an Intel CPU model means "no integrated graphics"; other Core models have it
inferred.cpu_brand_by_series: Derived by a rule: Core, Xeon, Pentium, Celeron are Intel CPUs; Ryzen, Athlon, Threadripper are AMD
inferred.gpu_vendor_by_chip: Derived by a rule: GeForce RTX/GTX chips are made by NVIDIA, Radeon RX by AMD, Arc by Intel
inferred.board_size_by_chipset: Derived by a rule: the letter M after the chipset (B760M) means Micro-ATX, the letter I — Mini-ITX
inferred.resolution_by_name: Derived by a rule: FHD = 1920×1080, QHD = 2560×1440, UHD/4K = 3840×2160
inferred.printer_single_by_default: Derived by a rule: sellers always name a multifunction device (MFP, 3 in 1, fax); without such words it is a plain printer
inferred.ram_dimm_by_default: Derived by a rule: sellers always mark laptop memory (SODIMM); without that mark it is regular DIMM memory for a PC
inferred.ram_brand_by_series: The seller did not give the brand — it is derived from the series name (Trident Z → G.Skill, Vengeance → Corsair, Fury → Kingston)

reason.ddr_mismatch: The description gives {{gens}} at the same time. It may be a mistake in the price list — ask the seller about the memory type: modules of different generations are not interchangeable.
reason.gpu_nonexistent: There is no {{model}} graphics card (maybe {{suggestion}} was meant). Ask the seller for the exact model.
reason.server_kit: This may be server hardware: an X99 + Xeon kit is a Chinese board and a server CPU, often used. Ask the seller about the condition and compatibility.
reason.server_xeon: This may be server hardware: Xeon is a server CPU, often sold used after working in data centers. Ask the seller about the condition and compatibility.
reason.server_board: This may be a Chinese X99/X79 board for server CPUs: the warranty and BIOS can be unreliable. Ask the seller about the maker.
reason.server_ecc: This may be ECC/REG server memory: it may not work in regular boards. Ask the seller about compatibility.
reason.server_socket: Socket {{socket}} is a server or outdated platform. Ask the seller about the condition and compatibility.
reason.mining_gpu: The description has signs of mining: the card may have worked under load for a long time. Ask the seller about its history and warranty.
reason.mining_psu: This may be a power supply for mining farms: usually without the right connectors and noisy. Ask the seller.
reason.mining_server_psu: This may be a server power supply or a PSU for mining. Ask the seller whether it suits a regular PC.
reason.mining_used_series: Used graphics cards of this series are often sold after mining. Ask the seller where the card was used.
reason.used_as_new: The item is marked new, but the description says "{{word}}". It may be used or refurbished — ask the seller.
reason.flash_capacity: A {{tb}} TB flash drive or memory card — these often turn out fake: the real capacity is much smaller. Check the drive with a program (for example, H2testw) when buying.
reason.ssd_cheap: The price is about ${{per_tb}} per TB — suspiciously low for an SSD. The real capacity may be smaller than stated — ask the seller.
reason.psu_noname: A power supply without a brand: the real power may be lower than stated, protections are often missing. Ask the seller for the model and certificate.
reason.psu_cheap: A {{watts}} W power supply for ${{price}} is suspiciously cheap. The real power may be lower than stated.
reason.psu_no_brand: The power supply brand is not given. Ask the seller who makes it.
reason.below_market: The price is {{percent}}% below the market average (${{median}} at {{count}} stores). It may be a mistake or a different item — ask the seller.
reason.ai_spec_mismatch: AI noticed that the specs in the row may contradict each other. Ask the seller.
reason.ai_server_hardware: AI noticed signs of server hardware. Ask the seller whether it suits a regular PC.
reason.ai_mining: AI noticed signs that the item may have been used for mining. Ask the seller.
reason.ai_used_as_new: AI noticed signs of a used or refurbished item. Ask the seller about the condition.
reason.ai_fake_capacity: AI noticed that the stated capacity may not match the real one. Ask the seller.
reason.ai_noname_psu: AI noticed that the power supply may have no known brand. Ask the seller.
reason.no_lhr: A card without the mining limiter — ask about its history of use.
reason.build_name_mismatch: The name or description says {{said}}, but the parts list has {{actual}}. Ask the seller.
reason.build_psu_brand: The power supply maker is not given — ask the seller.

error.file: Could not read the file. An Excel file (.xlsx) is needed
error.no_header: No header row found in the file (a "Product" or "ALT code" column)
error.no_branches: The file has no columns named after your branches
error.no_warehouse: the warehouse is not turned on in the store profile
error.reserved: the product is reserved for a buyer
error.warehouse_stock: there is stock left in the warehouse
error.stocktake_state: the stocktake is already at another step — refresh the page

mode.title: Stock keeping
mode.priceHint: Stock comes from price lists and hand edits, as before.
mode.stockHint: Quantities change only by operations: receipt, sale, adjustment, reservations, stock import. Everything is in the journal.
mode.confirmText: The current stock becomes the opening balance: {{rows}} rows go into the journal as "opening balance". After that quantities change only by operations in "Stock"; editing quantities in "My products" is turned off.
mode.confirmUnknown: {{count}} items have no quantity — they stay "available, quantity not given" until you record a receipt or an adjustment.
mode.confirmRes: Confirmed reservations ({{count}}) get a hold if there is enough stock.
mode.offText: Reservation holds are released, the movement journal is kept. You can turn stock keeping on again any time.
mode.on: Stock keeping is on: opening balances — {{initial}}, reservations on hold — {{reserved}}
mode.onShort_one: {{count}} confirmed reservation could not get a hold — it is in "Overview"
mode.onShort_other: {{count}} confirmed reservations could not get a hold — they are in "Overview"
mode.lowStockHint: "Overview" lists products with no more than this available

overview.lowHint: No more than {{count}} pcs available in at least one branch
overview.unreservedHint: Confirmed, but there was not enough stock. Record a receipt or change the branch
overview.oversold: Sold more than the books show
overview.oversoldHint: Check these products at the stocktake
overview.soldResHint: The item was sold at the till — offer the buyer a replacement or cancel the reservation
overview.onlyWarehouseHint: This product is in no branch — buyers see "out of stock"

excel.point1: Only quantities change, prices do not
excel.point2: A file from “My products” works — columns named after branches
excel.point3: An empty cell or “+” — no change
excel.drop: Drag an .xlsx here or choose a file
excel.nothing: Nothing will change — the stock in the file matches the current one

reports.title: Reports
reports.soon: Revenue, profit and reports — coming soon
reports.text: This section is in development. Sales and purchase prices are already written into the movement journal — reports will appear here based on them. For now the journal can be downloaded as Excel.

reservation.reserved: {{count}} pcs on hold in the branch
reservation.notReserved: No hold placed — not enough stock
reservation.soldOut: The item was sold — offer a replacement or cancel the reservation

modeHints.receipt: Goods came from a supplier. Beep each box: a repeat adds +1. An unknown barcode — add the product right away.
modeHints.move: Move goods from the warehouse to the store: taken from the warehouse, added to the branch.
modeHints.sale: Beep the item at the till: a repeat adds one more. The price is the current one, you can correct it.
modeHints.return: A buyer returned the item. A defective one may stay out of stock.
modeHints.adjust: Set the exact quantity of one product, for example after recounting a shelf.

priceOnly.title: Stock works in the "Stock keeping" mode
priceOnly.text: Right now the storefront stock comes from your price lists. Turn on stock keeping — and you can receive goods with a scanner beep, sell, take returns and do stocktakes, while the storefront stock updates by itself.

warehouse.oversoldWarn: More than the books show ({{qty}}) — the sale goes through, the item is marked "check at the stocktake"
warehouse.reservedWarn: Part of the item is reserved for a buyer ({{count}} pcs)
warehouse.reservedText: The item is reserved for a buyer, sell it anyway? The reservation gets the note "item sold — offer a replacement or cancel the reservation".
warehouse.restockHint: A defective item does not go back in stock — the journal gets a "return, defect" entry

box.title: Store warehouse
box.onHint: You receive goods into the warehouse and move them to stores by "Shelving". Buyers do not see the warehouse.
box.offHint: The warehouse and the store are in one place: you receive goods straight into the branch.
box.onText: Receiving goes to the warehouse, goods reach branches through "Shelving". On the storefront warehouse goods are "out of stock" until shelved.
box.offText: There will be no "Shelving" mode, receiving goes straight to a branch.
box.offStock: The warehouse still has {{positions}} items ({{units}} pcs). What to do with them?
box.priceNote: Receiving and shelving work in the "Stock keeping" mode.

stocktake.title: Stocktake
stocktake.hint: Beep every item on the shelf. At the end we show what is missing, what is extra and what was never found. The count is saved — you can close the page and continue.
stocktake.progress: Items counted: {{found}} of {{expected}} on the books
stocktake.cancelAsk: Cancel the stocktake? The count will be lost, the stock will not change.
stocktake.applyAsk: Apply {{count}} stock corrections? They go into the journal with the type "Stocktake".
stocktake.empty: Beep the first item on the shelf
stocktake.adjustLink: Need to fix one product without a stocktake?

error.checksum: The code was read with an error — scan again
error.format: This does not look like a barcode: 4–32 characters without spaces
error.taken: This code is already bound to the product "{{name}}"

camera.title: Point the camera at the barcode
camera.hint: Hold the box straight, the barcode across the red line. The camera closes by itself once the code is read.
camera.insecure: The camera works only on a secure site (https) — open the cabinet at https://… or use a USB scanner.
camera.denied: No access to the camera. Allow it in the browser settings and try again.
camera.none: No camera found on this device.
camera.failed: Could not start barcode recognition in this browser.

bind.title: Add the product with this barcode
bind.unknown: You do not have this barcode yet:
bind.common: This code is confirmed in the ALT STORES common base — it is the product:
bind.mine: Already in "My products"? Find it and bind

field.title: Barcodes
field.hint: You can type it, scan it into this field with a USB scanner or use the camera. A product may have several codes. When a second store binds the same code to the same card, it goes into the common base and buyers find the product by the code on the box.

scan.title: Scanning
scan.hint: Beep the box with a USB scanner (no need to put the cursor in the field) or the phone camera. Each scan is a document row, a repeat adds +1. "Record" writes the document into the stock journal.
scan.findEmpty: Scan a product or find it by name — stock by branch, price and cost appear here.

box.title: Scan the box
box.hint: Beep the barcode with a USB scanner (no need to place the cursor) or the camera. You can also type the code and press Enter.

panel.label: Barcode scanned
panel.add: Add a product with this code

admin.subtitle: administration
admin.noAccessText: This section opens only for the administrator.
admin.reasonHint: The blocked person will see it

overview.title: Overview
overview.noChannels: No channels — add them in "Telegram channels"

stores.title: Stores
stores.privacy: Stock, purchase prices and the stock journal are the seller's data; the administrator does not see them.
stores.blockHint: Products, builds and branches are hidden from the storefront and "Stores", the store is left out of the market price; new reservations are closed, existing ones stay visible to both sides. No data is deleted.

reports.title: Chat reports
reports.onlyThis: The administrator sees only this conversation.
reports.blockUserHint: The user will not be able to log in, write or reserve.

flags.title: Disputed Anti-Fraud flags
flags.answerHint: The seller will see it next to their offer
flags.dismissHint: The flag is removed and will not come back with the next price list uploads.

fixes.title: Card corrections
fixes.result: After the dictionary and normalizer it becomes
fixes.duplicate: Possible duplicate (found by the database check)
fixes.merge: Matches another card — the cards will be merged
fixes.mergeItems: Moves over: offers {{offers}} (one store has both — {{same_store}}), reservations {{reservations}}, conversations {{conversations}}, barcodes {{barcodes}}, stock rows {{stock_rows}}
fixes.resultError: The correction does not pass the check

barcodes.title: Barcodes — conflicts
barcodes.hint: Stores bound one code to different cards. Choose the right one or reject all bindings.
barcodes.noBindings: The code is bound to nothing
barcodes.rejectAllHint: The code does not go into the common base; the stores keep their bindings marked "disputed by the admin".

channels.title: Telegram channels
channels.addHint: We first check that the public feed t.me/s/<name> opens.
channels.fetchHint: No more than 50 posts at a time (free AI limits)
channels.logLine: On the page {{fetched}}, new {{new}}, ads {{parsed}}, offers {{offers}}, sold {{sold}}, deleted {{gone}}
channels.deleteHint: The channel leaves the list, its ads are hidden from the storefront. No data is deleted.

users.title: Users
users.noAdminHere: The administrator role is not given here — only by a script on the server. The administrator does not see passwords.

error.answer_required: Write an answer to the seller
error.bad_card: This card is not linked to the code
error.not_disputable: This flag can no longer be disputed
error.channel_name: Channel name: Latin letters, digits and _, at least 4 characters
error.channel_unreachable: The public feed t.me/s/… did not open — the channel is private or the name does not exist
error.channel_empty: The public feed has no posts
error.barcode_checksum: Wrong check digit of the code

photos.title: Card photos
photos.hint: All stores selling the card see the model photo. Check that the photo shows that very product, without others' watermarks or ads. The largest photo is suggested as the main one by default.
photos.none: No photo yet — the category icon is shown
photos.rejectHint: The seller will see the reason in a notification.

place.iAmInHint: The place for receiving, sales and the scanner panel
place.label: Place: {{place}}
place.choose: Where are you now: the warehouse or a branch

notify.title: Notifications
notify.emptyHint: New messages, reservations and important events will appear here.

text.message_other: {{count}} new messages from a buyer, the last: "{{text}}"
text.oversold: Sold more than the books show: {{name}} — check at the stocktake
text.import_ready: Price list "{{name}}" is parsed — check and publish it
text.import_failed: Could not parse the price list "{{name}}"
text.admin_flag_upheld: The administrator kept the mark on "{{name}}"
text.admin_flag_dismissed: The administrator removed the mark from "{{name}}"
text.admin_barcode_resolved: The administrator settled the dispute over barcode {{code}}
text.admin_barcode_rejected: Barcode {{code}} removed from the common base
text.admin_store_on: The store was blocked by the administrator: {{reason}}
text.report: New report about a chat with "{{store}}"
text.barcode_conflict: Barcode conflict {{code}}: stores bound different cards

photo.drop: Drop photos here, paste with Ctrl+V or
photo.formats: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB, from 400 px. Better from 1000 px — the photo becomes a 1500×1500 square.
photo.small: The photo is small — it may look blurry on the storefront, better from 1000 px

auto.white: White background: the product is found and fitted into the safe zone
auto.blur: Busy background: a blurred copy behind, the whole product in front

photo.rights: I have the right to use this photo (my own photo or the maker's photo)
photo.rightsNeeded: Confirm that you have the right to use the photo
photo.sole: Only you sell this card — the photo is published at once.
photo.moderated: Several stores sell this model — the administrator checks a new photo first. During the review buyers see the previous photo.
photo.usedHint: Photograph the item itself — buyers of used goods trust real photos
photo.offerHint: Your photos of this very item. Shown only in your offer.
photo.cardHint: The model photo is one for all stores, like the maker's.
photo.buildHint: Photos of your build, up to 6.

cropper.title: Cropping
cropper.hint: Move the photo with the mouse or a finger, zoom with the wheel, two fingers or the slider. The dashed line is the safe zone: the product must be inside.
cropper.frame: 1500×1500 frame, the dashed line is the safe zone

err.format: This format does not fit — JPEG, PNG or WebP is needed
err.not_image: The file does not look like a picture
err.too_heavy: The file is heavier than {{mb}} MB
err.too_big: The photo is larger than {{px}} px on a side
err.too_small: The short side of the photo is under {{px}} px — too small
err.rights: Confirm that you have the right to use the photo
err.limit: {{limit}} photos were already uploaded today — the store's daily limit
err.locked: Other stores already see this photo — suggest another one
err.not_yours: Photos can be added only to your own product
err.card_full: The card already has {{max}} photos — reject one first

forSellers.login: Already have a cabinet? Sign in

benefit.price: A price list in any format → the catalog
benefit.priceText: Excel, PDF, text or a Telegram post — the system finds products, specs and prices itself. You check and publish.
benefit.stock: Stock keeping and a warehouse with a scanner
benefit.stockText: Stock by branch, receiving, shelving, sales and stocktaking — barcodes by a scanner or a phone camera. Move from Excel without losing anything.
benefit.buyersText: A buyer reserves a product without paying and writes to you about a specific product or build — all in one cabinet.
benefit.marketText: Your prices next to the market price, indices by category and checks of suspicious offers that protect honest sellers.

forSellers.ctaText: Registration is free: upload a file and your products are in the catalog in a few minutes.
